title: Applied Music
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

why: the blocks sum to 3.0-3.0; the catalog states 12.0-12.0

outcomes: demonstrate the basic technical skills necessary to perform repertoire (for performers) or create and present original works (for composers) in their area of applied study; demonstrate effective skills to address the challenges of musical collaboration, performance, and presentation; and demonstrate the ability to make meaningful observations and provide constructive feedback about musical performances or compositions.

notes: The catalog lists MUSIC 92 (2 units) four times and MUSIC 94 (1 unit) four times, one per semester of the four-semester program. Each is recorded once in the block; the 12-unit total reflects four repetitions of each (4 x 2 + 4 x 1).
The block also requires application, audition, and acceptance into the four-semester SMC Applied Music Program. This is not a course.

The Program Learning Outcomes are printed as one sentence with three semicolon-separated clauses. They are recorded as one entry without the lead-in 'Upon completion of the program, students will'; the reviewer may check whether to treat the clauses as separate outcomes.
The Area of Emphasis (12 units) and Required Courses (12 units) state the same total.
The Guitar and Piano certificate sections that follow on the page were ignored.
